# Setup a React portfolio with Vite (2025-08-28 07:25Z)

_**User (2025-08-28 07:25Z)**_

You are my project setup agent. Create a minimal, production-ready React + Vite (TypeScript) portfolio skeleton with routing and deployment rewrites. Do everything end-to-end using **Yarn** as the package manager.

## 0) Project scaffold
- Initialize a Vite + React + TypeScript app named `portfolio`.
- Use Yarn.
- After creating, install `react-router-dom`.

Commands to run:
1) yarn create vite portfolio --template react-ts
2) cd portfolio
3) yarn
4) yarn add react-router-dom

## 1) Package scripts
Edit package.json to include these scripts (merge or add if needed):
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview --strictPort --port 5173",
    "lint": "echo \"(optional) add eslint later\""
  }
}

## 2) File structure (create/overwrite as needed)
- public/
  - favicon.svg (simple placeholder)
  - og.png (placeholder blank file)
  - resume.pdf (placeholder blank file)
  - _redirects (for Netlify SPA routing)
- vercel.json (for Vercel SPA rewrites)
- index.html (add meta/OG tags)
- src/
  - main.tsx
  - App.tsx
  - index.css (basic reset; Tailwind will be added later by me)
  - pages/
    - Home.tsx
    - Projects.tsx
    - Resume.tsx
    - NotFound.tsx
  - components/
    - Header.tsx
    - Footer.tsx
- README.md

## 3) File contents
(… 동일 — npm 버전에서 준 모든 파일 그대로 작성 …)

## 4) Verify
- Run: `yarn dev` (localhost)
- Build: `yarn build` then `yarn preview`
- For Vercel: import repo → build cmd `yarn build`, output `dist`
- For Netlify: build `yarn build`, publish `dist`

When done, return SUCCESS.

- 
- This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.
- 
- Currently, two official plugins are available:
- 
- - [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Babel](https://babeljs.io/) for Fast Refresh
- - [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/) for Fast Refresh
- 
- ## Expanding the ESLint configuration
- 
- If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

+ # Portfolio
+ 
+ A modern, production-ready portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
+ 
+ ## 🚀 Tech Stack
+ 
+ - **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript
+ - **Build Tool**: Vite
+ - **Routing**: React Router DOM
+ - **Styling**: Custom CSS with utility classes
+ - **Package Manager**: Yarn
+ 
+ ## 📁 Project Structure
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ portfolio/
+ ├── public/
+ │   ├── favicon.svg          # Site favicon
+ │   ├── og.png              # Open Graph image (placeholder)
+ │   ├── resume.pdf          # Resume download (placeholder)
+ │   └── _redirects          # Netlify SPA routing
+ ├── src/
+ │   ├── components/
+ │   │   ├── Header.tsx      # Navigation header
+ │   │   └── Footer.tsx      # Site footer
+ │   ├── pages/
+ │   │   ├── Home.tsx        # Landing page
+ │   │   ├── Projects.tsx    # Projects showcase
+ │   │   ├── Resume.tsx      # Resume/experience
+ │   │   └── NotFound.tsx    # 404 page
+ │   ├── App.tsx             # Main app component
+ │   ├── main.tsx            # App entry point
+ │   └── index.css           # Global styles
+ ├── index.html              # HTML template with SEO meta tags
+ ├── vercel.json             # Vercel deployment config
+ └── package.json            # Dependencies and scripts
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🛠️ Development
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ - Node.js (v18+)
+ - Yarn package manager
+ 
+ ### Getting Started
+ 
+ 1. **Clone the repository**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    git clone &lt;your-repo-url&gt;
+    cd portfolio
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Install dependencies**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    yarn
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. **Start development server**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    yarn dev
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+    
+    Open [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173) in your browser.
+ 
+ ### Available Scripts
+ 
+ - &#96;yarn dev&#96; - Start development server
+ - &#96;yarn build&#96; - Build for production
+ - &#96;yarn preview&#96; - Preview production build locally
+ - &#96;yarn lint&#96; - Run linter (placeholder for now)
+ 
+ ## 🚢 Deployment
+ 
+ ### Vercel
+ 
+ 1. Import your repository to Vercel
+ 2. Set build command: &#96;yarn build&#96;
+ 3. Set output directory: &#96;dist&#96;
+ 4. Deploy!
+ 
+ The &#96;vercel.json&#96; file handles SPA routing automatically.
+ 
+ ### Netlify
+ 
+ 1. Connect your repository to Netlify
+ 2. Set build command: &#96;yarn build&#96;
+ 3. Set publish directory: &#96;dist&#96;
+ 4. Deploy!
+ 
+ The &#96;public/_redirects&#96; file handles SPA routing automatically.
+ 
+ ## 🎨 Customization
+ 
+ ### Content
+ 
+ - Update personal information in &#96;src/pages/Home.tsx&#96;
+ - Add your projects in &#96;src/pages/Projects.tsx&#96;
+ - Update experience in &#96;src/pages/Resume.tsx&#96;
+ - Modify contact links in &#96;src/components/Footer.tsx&#96;
+ 
+ ### Styling
+ 
+ - Global styles are in &#96;src/index.css&#96;
+ - Uses utility-first CSS classes
+ - Ready for Tailwind CSS integration
+ 
+ ### SEO
+ 
+ - Update meta tags in &#96;index.html&#96;
+ - Replace placeholder Open Graph image (&#96;public/og.png&#96;)
+ - Add your actual resume PDF (&#96;public/resume.pdf&#96;)
+ 
+ ## 📝 Features
+ 
+ - ✅ Responsive design
+ - ✅ SEO optimized with meta tags
+ - ✅ Client-side routing
+ - ✅ TypeScript for type safety
+ - ✅ Production-ready build
+ - ✅ Deployment configurations for Vercel &amp; Netlify
+ - ✅ Clean, modern UI
+ - ✅ Accessible navigation
+ 
+ ## 🔧 Next Steps
+ 
+ 1. **Add your content**: Replace placeholder text with your actual information
+ 2. **Style customization**: Add Tailwind CSS or your preferred styling solution
+ 3. **Add assets**: Replace placeholder images and PDF
+ 4. **SEO optimization**: Update meta tags with your information
+ 5. **Analytics**: Add Google Analytics or your preferred analytics solution
+ 6. **Performance**: Optimize images and add lazy loading
+ 7. **Testing**: Add unit tests with Vitest or Jest
+ 
+ ## 📄 License
+ 
+ This project is open source and available under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
